description: This Java source file defines a service class CreateDatatableEntryCommandHandler that handles commands to create new entries in a datatable within the Fineract infrastructure. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the creation process to DatatableWriteService.

classes.name: CreateDatatableEntryCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that processes commands for creating new datatable entries, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and using transaction management.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JsonCommand to create a new datatable entry by delegating to datatableWriteService.
